speaker: john_heminges
text: Well. It went. I am not going to call it mended because a Friday happened.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I came through the dry place once. Once. I did not stop, and I did not ask anyone's pardon.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Once is a number. Tuesday was four, and four pardons. I will take once, and I will not build a feast on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The eight lines held. I am not proud of them. They held on Tuesday too, and Tuesday was no better.

speaker: john_sincler
text: The doublet met, which is more than Tuesday gave me. I am not a rake this afternoon. Do not make that a victory either.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is making a victory. The old Knave was played. It has not been played since February. Played is not the same word as known.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I know where the hole is. I walked over it once without falling in. Tomorrow I might fall in. I am only saying that today I did not.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then say that, and sit down. A man who apologises to nobody has had a better day than a man who apologises to four. He has not had a triumph.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No triumph. The justice was eight lines, and they came out in the order they are written. That is the whole boast, and it is a small one.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Small, and true. I heard them. I also heard the house, which wanted the jig more than it wanted the justice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The house may want what it wants. I want a book that does not depend on a man stepping over a hole. We have not got that book. We had an afternoon.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: An afternoon, and no apology from me. I nearly made one out of habit, at the exit, and I swallowed it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Swallow the next one too, if the next one is only manners. If you dry, apologise. If you do not dry, do not decorate it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not decorate the eight. They are a justice in a play that was pulled out because Friday needed it. Friday has had it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, it went. Item, Cowley came through once. Item, I am not shutting a bag over a play to make it better than it was.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Leave the bag till Saturday. Today the lean man had a doublet, and the fat man stayed on his feet. I can live on that until tomorrow.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I stayed on my feet. The barrel was Tuesday's. I am not wearing Tuesday in order to be thanked.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then we are agreed. Once, and nobody thanked, and nobody pardoned. I can carry that home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Carry it. I am not writing it up. The king is another paper, and Kemp has not been shown that paper, and this afternoon is not the occasion to show him.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Kemp is not the subject. The subject is a Knave that got from the start to the end with one clean pass at the bad place. We break. We do not celebrate.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I was not going to celebrate. I was going to get out of the doublet before it learns my name.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Go, then. Once is once. Eight is eight. I will not add them together and call them a new play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Saturday can have the bag. Friday has had the play. That is enough division for one week.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will not come back to the hole tonight to admire it. Once was the work.

speaker: john_sincler
text: And I will not wear the doublet to supper in order to remember that it met.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor will I. Home, and the lines as they were. Not proud.
